description: Port of Clippy 0.1.99's mixed_case_hex_literals: reports a hexadecimal integer literal whose digits (after `0x`, before the type suffix and the `_` before it) hold both a lowercase and an uppercase letter. A type suffix starts with `i` or `u`, which no digit run crosses.

violation.message: Clippy mixed_case_hex_literals: inconsistent casing in hexadecimal literal
